Class MultiregionReport

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.multiregion.MultiregionReport
public final class MultiregionReport extends Object
The problems the multi-region check found, and SQL that fixes them. A contradiction (an annotation that names one locality while the table has the other, or annotations that disagree with each other) is a problem that throws even in Mode.WARN.

Returned by Crdb.verifyLocality(DataSource, Class...) so a caller can inspect what was found. When the check throws (validate mode, or any contradiction), the thrown IllegalStateException's message is this report's format(Mode).
